prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI public landing page redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for page purpose, hero hierarchy, and public entry flow, not an edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 23-X-01-product-landing/default.
Direction: product-first calm TOPIK landing.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 web landing page screenshot, no browser chrome and no OS window frame. First viewport must clearly show TALKPIK AI branding, top navigation, login entry, a concise hero headline about TOPIK writing AI practice, one dark start CTA, and real product preview panels for dashboard, writing practice, feedback, and report. Keep a subtle mascot or character as secondary support, not the main content. Let the next section hint appear below the fold.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly public page structure, polished but restrained.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 canvas, Snow #ffffff panels, Fog #ececee dividers, Obsidian #09090b primary CTA, muted neutral text.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing, no viewport-scaled text.
Constraints: product screen previews should be inspectable and not dark/blurred; CTA count must stay restrained; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS window frame, loud AI gradients, purple/blue SaaS glow, stock-people imagery, generic abstract hero art, oversized decorative bubbles, repeated colorful CTAs, watermark.
